coverage: Preview and bootstrap have independent timestamps after provider readiness.
Failed preview registration records its start but neither dispatches nor claims bootstrap completion.
SSH retry timing preserves the first request time and counts every attempt without repeating private preview registration.
Saved-runtime compatibility is measured separately before preview setup.
observationAcceptance.clockMethod: Node mock Date with deterministic fake provider/SSH durations. No provider delay is forced live.
